articles.title_en: Putin says the Russian stock market is just ‘slightly in the red.’ (It’s in its longest losing streak since 2008.)
articles.lead_en: The Russian stock market is “slightly in the red” but will gradually recover, Russian President Vladimir Putin said at the plenary session of the Eastern Economic Forum. Over the past six months, however, the Moscow Exchange index (IMOEX) has lost more than 22%.
